claims.text: Rosewood Mandarina is in Riviera Nayarit, Mexico.

findings.quote: Rosewood MandarinaRiviera Nayarit, Mexico

claims.text: Accommodation is all suites, with views over the natural terrain of Riviera Nayarit.

findings.quote: All-suite accommodations offer full immersion into the natural terrain of Riviera Nayarit.

claims.text: The suites have views of the ocean, the flatlands and the mountains.

findings.quote: With sweeping views of the ocean, flatlands, and mountains that transform with the sunlight, the suites at Rosewood Mandarina

claims.text: The premium villas are the most spacious accommodation in the resort, with indoor and outdoor space suited to families and small groups.

findings.quote: The most spacious in the resort, offering expansive indoor and outdoor space perfect for families, small groups of friends

claims.text: Buena Onda is a casual beach shack at the base of the mountain, by the Pacific, serving Spanish coastal food: grilled seafood, tapas and paellas.

findings.quote: A casual beach shack serving a Spanish coastal menu of grilled seafood, tapas, and paellas
A beachfront oasis at the mountain’s base, this casual shack serves Spanish coastal fare—grilled seafood, tapas, paellas—with cocktails and sangria by the Pacific.

claims.text: Toppu combines Japanese technique with Mexican flavors.

findings.quote: Toppu blends the precision of Japanese technique with vibrant Mexican flavors

claims.text: The resort offers an Agave Experience on tequila, mezcal, sotol and other agave spirits with its Head Tequilero.

findings.quote: Discover the world of the agave plant and its spirits — tequila, mezcal, sotol, and more — with our talented Head Tequilero.

claims.text: Guests can take a Mexican cooking class on ancestral techniques with the culinary team.

findings.quote: Learn ancestral Mexican cooking techniques alongside our talented culinary team.

claims.text: Private dinners can be set on the beach by torchlight.

findings.quote: Beachside Private Dining
torches provide the lighting, and the stars twinkle overhead as you indulge in a moonlit culinary experience by the sea

claims.text: Menus use ingredients from a network of local producers.

findings.quote: Our menus use the freshest ingredients from our network of local producers.

claims.text: Summer activities include sea turtle releases and ocean adventures.

findings.quote: Step into a season of ocean adventures, sea turtle releases, and meaningful moments immersed in Mandarina’s natural beauty.

claims.text: Each specialty suite has living and dining space and a private plunge pool.

findings.quote: each suite has generous living and dining space, a relaxing private plunge pool and much more.

claims.text: The Polo & Equestrian Club sits on the flatlands beneath the Sierra Madre peaks, where guests of all ages can ride, learn or watch seasonal polo matches.

findings.quote: Set on Mandarina’s lush flatlands beneath the Sierra Madre peaks, the Polo & Equestrian Club invites guests of all ages to ride, learn, or watch seasonal polo matches.

claims.text: Mandarina Golf Club is a 9-hole par-3 course designed by Greg Norman, with mountain views.

findings.quote: Designed by Greg Norman, the 9-hole par-3 course unfolds across Mandarina’s green flatlands, offering dramatic mountain views

claims.text: Barra Peñasco is an open-air bar perched on a cliff among ancient fig trees, with cocktails, Mexican spirits and live music at sunset.

findings.quote: Perched on a cliff among ancient fig trees, Barra Peñasco is an open-air bar where cocktails, Mexican spirits, and live music come alive with the setting sun over the horizon.

claims.text: Guests can take a panga to the Islas Marietas, a protected National Reserve of uninhabited islands, to spot rare birds and see Playa del Amor beneath a crater.

findings.quote: The Islas Marietas is a group of uninhabited islands and a protected National Reserve. Take a panga across the water, spot rare birds and discover the Playa del Amor, a private beach beneath a breathtaking crater.

claims.text: La Cocina Mandarina is the all-day restaurant, built around a traditional comal that makes handmade tortillas.

findings.quote: La Cocina Mandarina (which translates to ‘Mandarina’s kitchen’) is our all-day dining restaurant anchored by a traditional comal producing handmade tortillas.

claims.text: Sea turtle releases are offered as part of the summer season.

findings.quote: Summer at Mandarina
Step into a season of ocean adventures, sea turtle releases

claims.text: Polo matches are seasonal.

findings.quote: watch seasonal polo matches
In polo season (the North American winter), you can watch games
